messages.content: 오늘은 팔이 좀 뻐근하네요. 주말마다 클라이밍을 하는데, 어제는 어려운 코스에 도전했거든요.
Oof, sounds like your arms earned a break! How do you usually unwind afterward?
After climbing, I usually stop at Blue Bookshop. I can sit there and read for a while without looking at my phone.
That sounds like a lovely way to slow down. Where is it?
파란책방, 그러니까 Blue Bookshop은 연남동에 있어요. 작은 가게라 처음엔 그냥 지나칠 뻔했어요.
Those little places can be easy to miss! Do you prefer a gentler workout during the week?
Yeah, I go jogging before work on weekday mornings. Nothing serious, just enough to wake myself up.
A short run can really clear your head. Do you head straight home afterward?
Not always. After jogging, I sometimes stop at Lake Cafe and sit outside if the weather is nice.
A little outdoor break sounds nice. How do you get to work after that?
출퇴근은 자전거로 해요. 버스 기다리는 것보다 마음이 편하더라고요.
I can see the appeal of going at your own pace. Do your coworkers enjoy being outdoors too?
동료 수빈이는 등산을 좋아해서 자꾸 같이 가자고 해요. 아직 따라갈 자신은 없어요.
You could ask to start with an easy trail! Would you like to practice inviting someone along in English?
Actually, I want to practice casual conversations with travelers. I sometimes meet them around town and never know what to say.
We can work on that together. Next time, let's start with a simple conversation about your day.
오늘은 퇴근하고 스케치 수업에 다녀왔어요. 평일 저녁에 듣는 수업인데 아직 사람 얼굴 그리는 게 어렵네요.
Faces are tricky! Does the teacher help you work through the difficult parts?
Yes, Hana teaches the sketching class. She tells us to look carefully before drawing, but I always rush.
Slowing down takes practice too. What are the breaks like?
Pretty relaxed. Hana usually drinks rooibos tea during breaks, and we chat while our hands get a rest.
That sounds cozy. Are you a tea person as well?
저는 그날그날 달라요. 친구 Mina는 항상 카푸치노를 주문해서 고민할 일이 없더라고요.
Having a usual order does make things easier! What do you like doing when you get home?
I usually read with my cat, Mochi, beside me. She sits right on the page if I ignore her for too long.
Ha, she knows how to get your attention. Do you have a snack while you read?
가끔요. 그런데 호두 알레르기가 있어서 과자 성분표는 꼭 확인해요. 밖에서 먹을 때도 신경 쓰이고요.
That sounds like an important habit. Are you eating out anytime soon?
네, 금요일 저녁에 도윤이랑 밥 먹기로 했어요. 오랜만에 만나서 할 얘기가 많아요.
It'll be nice to catch up. Have you heard where Doyun wants to eat?
Doyun picked Maple Kitchen. I have never been, so I am looking forward to trying it.
Trying somewhere new is fun. You'll have to tell me what you think!
지난번에 얘기한 식당 메뉴를 찾아봤어요. 메이플키친의 대표 메뉴가 버섯 리소토래요. 벌써 배고파지네요.
Now you're making me hungry too! Will you have time to do anything else while you're out?
I hope so. I need to find a birthday gift for my younger sister, Sohee, and I have left it a bit late.
That happens! What does she like doing in her free time?
소희는 도예를 좋아해요. 얼마 전에 직접 만든 컵 사진도 보내줬는데 꽤 잘 만들었더라고요.
A handmade cup sounds lovely. Have you found somewhere to look for supplies?
Yes, I decided to buy pottery supplies at Clay House. I might ask the staff for help choosing something.
That's a good idea when you're buying for someone else's hobby. When is your own birthday?
제 생일은 9월이에요. 아직 여유 있죠. 그 전에 이번 달 봉사활동 일정부터 챙겨야겠어요.
Sounds like you've got a busy month. What kind of volunteering do you do?
I join a river cleanup once a month. It is tiring, but seeing the path clean afterward feels really good.
I bet it does. Has the group decided on a meeting spot?
하천 정화 모임은 Willow Bridge에서 모여요. 처음 오는 사람한테 길을 설명해 줘야 해서 지도를 보고 있었어요.
A clear landmark should help. Which station exit would you tell them to use?
Exit 2 of Neulbom Station is the closest one to Willow Bridge. I should send them a screenshot as well.
That would make it much easier to find. Want to practice giving those directions in English next time?
